sparse_input.feature_schema: fixed original parser/fact/metadata order and scaling; matching width alone is insufficient

byte_features.normalization: row L2 on byte feature block before concatenating unchanged facts/metadata

sparse_input.ASA_view: registered verified syslog-header canonicalization followed by the original normalization chain
sparse_input.non_ASA_view: original R0 stable(view(raw)) byte statistics with fixed frozen-parser fact order; ASA-only placeholder_cluster is not applied to other routes

parsed_facts.encoding: fixed enums one-hot; numeric 1+log1p; finite-domain bits; original independent row L2 normalization

record_src_port.encoding: 16 port bits + observed + conflict with observed message port; divided by sqrt(18); no row L2; does not overwrite message port

normalization_order: identify and remove the verified ASA syslog-header span
original residual view with fixed identity/device/time span rules
body_residual_input.unknown_header_behavior: reject unmatched registered grammar; do not silently strip or guess

fold_usage.published_metrics: select model by original registered source-fold assignment for each evaluated record
fold_usage.three_fold_average_verification_scope: previously inspected official validation population of 2,014,052; not hidden contest test

raw_input.event_id_use: output identity only; nonempty unique strings; never a model feature

deployment.default_fold_strategy: mean of all available fold probabilities; a newly trained one-fold manifest selects that one fold
deployment.unsupported_ASA: full N1 sparse router for that fold; preserved and counted, never silently truncated or dropped
deployment.ID_coverage: one output per input ID; exact coverage independently checked by validate_submission.py
